description:
Step of fz-t93: a cycle group concludes together. Proposal page ../fz-afu.15.html (artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/4iwyuoz15h9ACqNe6QNb3x), probed end to end (scratchpad afu15a/report.md, followup.md, probe_v5_no_deferred.diff).

Design (probed): the engine owns groups. A group forms at partner detection: reader, producer, every job on the wait path producer ->* reader (the engine's wait graph, fz-t93.2), and any group those are already in. Reads between members are Partner (Current), so every climb step is carried by a wake that queues the next member at once. A group is open from formation and re-opened when a member is enqueued; it closes at a member's completion when no member is queued or waiting, and reports its facts concluded in one more dispatch. Concluded = locally settled AND publisher's group closed (separate from local settledness, which members use among themselves). A reader outside waits until close and reads the final answer once. ForwardingWalk: an answer that exists is a leaf (Partner or Concluded); only a partner with no answer is walked.

Probe results: json_roundtrip same/2 16 -> 8 (paper), decode ReturnType read once at its final revision; m8 shrink same/2 2 -> 1; fixture matrix 3358/0/3 ignored, outputs identical; distiller output identical; 9 json groups, one job kind each, largest 50 AnalyzeActivation; widening unchanged. Pins: falls census 2513->2511, 00571 (568,17)->(562,14); Partner-leaf fix restores a_forwarding_cycle (6) and enum_take (244); RISES needing approval: 00420 body walks 648->650 (early in-group runs; inherent), fz2_cli aggregate 1325->1327 (same), 00181 wakes 130->133 (coalesced wakes only, runs identical).

Removal ledger (corrected by probe): removes keying on unfinished rungs and ForwardingWalk's Partner body walk; waits_reach narrows to group formation. derive_up_before_down STAYS (it is the group's own climb; ladder counts unchanged). pending_strong_component goes with products-as-derivations (fz-t93.4/.7), not here.

Build order: (1) pin m8 and three.fz outside-reader-reads-once as failing trace tests; (2) engine groups + wait-path query (added back with its consumer) + Scheduler::is_concluded, engine unit tests in scheduler_test.rs; (3) ForwardingWalk leaf rule.

Close when: json same/2 = 8 with decode's return read once; fz-xxd.10 json ladder pin shows no climbing rows; outputs identical; falling pins lowered; rising pins only as approved.

Open: group splitting across edits (probe groups only grow; re-open on re-derivation); 4 of 50 json members not on an observed cycle; early local-settle flips re-parked by the pop gate (churn uncounted); settle_quiescent interaction.

History: original bug — roundtrip/1 reads Json.decode's ReturnType at revisions 1 and 2 and keys 16 same/2 activations (paper 8); fact_is_concluded holds between climb steps because a climb advances by revision wakes. Refuted cures S1-S5 (settled through unfinal reads; exempting the reader; settled along waits; plus a matching wake) — all failed because in-group reads were Concluded, so nothing recorded that members belong together.
title: A caller reads a recursive callee's return only once its climb has finished
